headline.text: MV Ocean Star's current voyage VG-1042 (SGSIN to NLRTM) is delayed 55 hours. Five customers have confirmed containers on it: Halden Retail 80, Kaimon Electronics 90, Petra Chemicals 45, Lumio Home 30 and Verdant Foods 22.

interpretation.text: I read 'Ocean Star's delay' as the in-progress voyage VG-1042 (status Delayed, revised ETA 2026-10-27 01:00 UTC against an original ETA of 2026-10-24 18:00 UTC). 'On board' means bookings still on VG-1042 with status Confirmed. The per-customer totals are my sums of the booking rows.

confirmed_facts.text: Halden Retail has 80 containers on VG-1042, from three bookings of 40, 25 and 15.
Kaimon Electronics has 90 containers, from two bookings of 60 and 30.
Lumio Home has 30 containers, from two bookings of 18 and 12.
All of these bookings carry a promised delivery date of 2026-10-28.

inferences.text: The 2026-10-28 promise looks tight for every confirmed booking. The vessel is not due at Rotterdam until 2026-10-27 01:00 UTC, and the berth window closed on 2026-10-25 04:00 UTC. This depends on actual arrival and discharge timing.
inferences.based_on: The revised ETA, the berth window and the promised delivery dates. The ETA is a projection.

exclusions.text: Northgate Auto's 50-container booking is marked 'Rolled to VG-1107', so I left it out of the on-board count. It is still affected, because it now depends on the next voyage, which is scheduled to depart on 2026-10-29.
Brightline Apparel's 20-container booking is Cancelled, so I excluded it.
